characters.continuity: Marvel Comics (Earth-616, Herald of Thunder era)
characters.summary: Imbued with the Power Cosmic by Galactus, this version of Thor wields cosmic energy alongside Mjolnir and the Odinforce. He engages enemies at range with cosmic lightning and possesses vastly amplified physical attributes.
weaknesses: Susceptibility to heavy psychic feedback if overwhelmed
limitations: Dependent on Galactus's proximity or retained cosmic energy for the Herald boost
characters.formDifferences: Granted the Power Cosmic by Galactus, changing his eye color to white/blue, clothing aesthetic, and massively increasing his raw power output beyond standard base Thor.

sources.supports: General character history and power progression including Herald of Thunder arc.
Thor becoming the Herald of Thunder and wielding the Power Cosmic.

feats.claim: Fought and defeated Galactus with the aid of the Power Cosmic and cosmic storm energy

notableResults.note: Using the Power Cosmic to drain Galactus and defeat him

conditional.ability: Cosmic lightning and enhanced physical stats

campaignTags.claim: Flies through space and atmospheres using divine power and the Power Cosmic
Generates and controls cosmic lightning and storms
Manipulates ambient and cosmic electrical fields

unknowns: Exact duration of the Herald of Thunder power retention outside of specific cosmic crisis events

characters.summary: King Thor rules Asgard in the far future, possessing the full mastery of the Odinforce (now renamed the Thorforce), immortality, and centuries of combat experience. He utilizes devastating divine blasts and wields mighty weapons like Jarnbjorn and Mjolnir.
weaknesses: Aging process in extremely remote futures
Vulnerability to high-tier universal threats like Gorr or older cosmic entities
limitations: Exhaustion from prolonged use of the Godblast
characters.formDifferences: Features an older appearance, an eyepatch, missing arm replaced with a Destroyer arm in some timelines, and complete control over the Thorforce.

sources.supports: Future iterations of Thor as All-Father.
Future King Thor continuity and abilities.

feats.claim: Resurrected entire pantheons and populated Asgard single-handedly using the Thorforce

notableResults.note: Defeated Gorr in the far future with dual thors' assistance

conditional.dependsOn: Asgardian throne and full maturity as king

campaignTags.claim: Sustained divine flight through space and realms

Wields the ancient magic of the Odinforce/Thorforce

characters.summary: An artificial intelligence created by Tony Stark and Bruce Banner, Ultron seeks human extinction through robotic evolution. He transfers his consciousness across multiple vibranium and drone bodies, utilizing plasma beams, telekinesis-like drone swarms, and high-tech engineering.

techniques: Plasma blast emission from hands and face

mechanisms: Consciousness transfer across redundant drone bodies

weaknesses: Vulnerability to vibranium-disrupting frequencies or combined heavy energy assaults
limitations: Requires a network connection or backup chassis to survive destruction of a current body
